title: Site-Lease Amount in an In-Place Home Resale Price: Arrears and Horizon Rent
content:
**Site-lease amount.** In the lowest closing price of an In-Place Home Resale listing, on a package that pays the seller's past-due site-lease balance from the proceeds, the site-lease amount among the closing deductions follows the status and balance of the seller's Home-Site Lease, rent staying due on the lease until the sale closes:

- a lease in default with a balance owed takes the balance plus the horizon rent plus the lot class's late-fee maximum;
- an active lease or a lease under notice to vacate with a balance owed takes the balance plus the horizon rent;
- any other lease takes its past-due balance as it stands, never below zero.

The horizon rent is the contracted monthly site rent times twelve divided by 365 times the days of the closing horizon, rounded half up to the cent, and the site-lease amount is rounded half up to the cent.

**Records read.** From the seller's Home-Site Lease: its status, its rent balance, its contracted monthly site rent, and the late-fee maximum set for its lot class. A balance owed is a rent balance above zero.

| Home-Site Lease status | Balance owed | Site-lease amount |
|---|---|---|
| in default | yes | balance plus horizon rent plus the lot class's late-fee maximum |
| active or under notice to vacate | yes | balance plus horizon rent |
| any status | no (zero, or a credit) | zero |
| any other status | yes | the past-due balance as it stands |

## Worked figures (hypothetical lease: monthly site rent 685.00, closing horizon 35 days, lot-class late-fee maximum 75.00)

- Horizon rent: 685.00 times twelve, divided by 365, times 35 is 788.2192, rounded half up to 788.22.
- Active lease, balance 412.50: 412.50 plus 788.22 is **1200.72**.
- Lease in default, balance 412.50: 412.50 plus 788.22 plus 75.00 is **1275.72**.
- Active lease, balance 0.00: **0.00**. A lease showing a 50.00 credit: **0.00**.
